title: Talking-head models turn a single photo into a speaking video
text: Audio-driven talking-head systems predict 3D face motion coefficients from speech and render them onto one still portrait. Recent open-source releases run on a consumer GPU in a few seconds per clip.

title: Open text-to-speech models can now clone a voice from a few seconds of audio
text: Multilingual neural speech synthesizers condition on a short reference recording to reproduce a speaker's timbre. Several of the strongest open models ship under non-commercial licenses.
